perspective:
Vincent Chinana’s available information:

- He knows he is a mechanic and that Patrick Guzman is his long-time friend; they met as teenagers, share blue-collar work, and have collaborated before, combining Vincent’s mechanical skills with Patrick’s construction expertise.
- At the diner, Vincent hears Patrick is considering a new construction venture/investment to expand his business. Vincent says he has heard it is risky, worries about financial security, and advises Patrick to reconsider or delay until more information is gathered. Patrick says he thinks it is worth the risk but is still weighing options, and appreciates Vincent’s concern.
- Over the next few days, Vincent notices Patrick avoiding detailed discussion about the investment. At Patrick’s construction site, Vincent tells Patrick he feels he is not being told everything and that he feels betrayed. Patrick apologizes, says it is complicated and he did not want to worry Vincent, and agrees to explain everything.
- During a detailed discussion at Vincent’s garage, Vincent learns from Patrick that the situation is serious, that Patrick might lose a significant amount if it does not turn around soon, and that it has been tough. Vincent offers to lend money to cover short-term losses. Patrick thanks him and expresses gratitude for the support.
- A month later, Vincent becomes aware of new information suggesting the venture might actually turn a profit. At the coffee shop, Vincent tells Patrick this. Patrick confirms it is starting to look up and says he is relieved they stuck with it. Vincent apologizes for doubting him and proposes a joint venture. Patrick agrees to work out the details.
- At Vincent’s house, Vincent is optimistic. He tells Patrick their combined skills can make the venture a success and begins drafting a business plan, saying they need to outline every step carefully. Patrick agrees to cover all bases.

Not available to Vincent: Patrick’s private unspoken thoughts or motives, hidden investment details not shared with Vincent, and narrator-only information.
